stem: Based on the excerpt and your knowledge of U.S. history, which line from the speech BEST explains the meaning of the motto “E pluribus unum”?

options.label: A
options.text: “We were born out of revolution against an empire.”

options.label: B
options.text: “We were founded upon the ideal that all are created equal. . . .”

options.label: C
options.text: “We have shed blood and struggled for centuries to give meaning to those words.”

options.label: D
options.text: “We are shaped by every culture, drawn from every end of the Earth. . . .”

visual_elements: Excerpt from a presidential speech: We were born out of revolution against an empire. We were founded upon the ideal that all are created equal, and we have shed blood and struggled for centuries to give meaning to those words. . . . We are shaped by every culture, drawn from every end of the Earth, and dedicated to a simple concept: E pluribus unum: “Out of many, one.” —President Barack H. Obama
